title: Doug Williams and the Spirits of Rhythm
summary: Punch recalls Doug Williams, a tiple and ukulele player who went to New York and became known with Leo Watson's group.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: Well, who was some of the outstanding men on those bands? I mean, yeah. Well, I don't know.
One boy, I was 50 feet. Now, I used to call him Doug. He was the lead of this band. Oh, yeah, they had, what you call them little things?
Is it kind of like a guitar? Yeah. Mandolin?

No. I did sing, or ukulele. Oh, yeah. Yeah. Yeah. But he started on mandolin. He had to be a great boy. He went to New York. Who's that? His name was Doug Williams.
